families.headline: Constructs ample rank-two bundles on $`\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1`$ with no smooth Hermitian metric of strictly Griffiths-positive curvature, disproving Griffiths' positivity conjecture already on the quadric surface.

clauses.clause: Constructs ample rank-two bundles on $`\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1`$
clauses.note: ∃ G and a sequence E m of AlgebraicRankTwoBundle (cocycle data of 2×2 regular transition matrices over principal opens of OnePoint ℂ × OnePoint ℂ) with E m the power pullback of G twisted by O(1,1), and IsAmple (E m) for every m>0. IsAmple = some positive symmetric power has finitely many global sections giving a base-point-free, injective, closed-image, locally-invertible map — very ampleness of O(n) on the projectivization, which is equivalent to ampleness.

clauses.clause: with no smooth Hermitian metric of strictly Griffiths-positive curvature
clauses.note: ∃ m₀>0 ∀ m ≥ m₀, ¬∃ h : SmoothHermitianMetric (E m) with h.StrictlyGriffithsPositive. The metric is a C^∞ positive-definite matrix field on the dual bundle per chart, compatible on overlaps; strict Griffiths positivity is PosDef of ∂_u∂̄_u K − (∂_u K)^* K^{-1} ∂_u K for every u ≠ 0 at every point. I re-derived that this is −⟨Θξ,ξ⟩ of the dual metric K, so PosDef ⇔ V* Griffiths-negative ⇔ V Griffiths-positive: the sign convention is right.

clauses.clause: disproving Griffiths' positivity conjecture already on the quadric surface
clauses.note: Follows from the two clauses above (a single ample bundle with no such metric is enough).

families.headline: Constructs viscous incompressible flows starting from rest on a fixed flat three-dimensional domain that perform universal computation under smooth external forcing. A terminating compiler turns a Turing machine and input into a finite program for the force, so a designated particle reaches a fixed region exactly when the machine halts. The viscosity is fixed, positive and computable.
